climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A cru village in the Côte des Blancs, an area of Champagne vineyards named for its grape: 95 percent is Chardonnay, and its champagnes carry the term blanc de blancs. Champagne's rules allow Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Meunier, plus a few other grapes.
